crm.sales.v1.Contract.description:
Contract is a signed sales agreement: the plan a customer bought, what it
costs monthly, and who signed. This domain contracts the read surface that
other apps need; create/update stay on CRM's legacy surface until that
migration happens.

A contract is "signed" when signed_at is present. Unsigned drafts exist so
sales can stage terms before signature, and callers must treat the two
states differently.

created_at.description: created_at is when the record was created.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the resource.

lead_id.description:
lead_id is the CRM lead this contract closes; absent for contracts
recorded without a lead.

mrr.description:
mrr is monthly recurring revenue as a decimal string, because money
crosses the wire as text to avoid float drift. Currency is the
business's reporting currency.

notes.description: notes are free-text sales notes; not for invoice prefill.

plan.description: plan is what was bought, as CRM displays it (e.g. "pro", "enterprise").

seats.description: seats is how many users the contract covers.

signed_at.description:
signed_at is when the customer signed (ISO-8601); absent on unsigned
drafts. Presence of this field is what makes a contract billable.

signed_by_name.description: signed_by_name is the customer-side signer as written at signature time.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the record was last updated.

crm.sales.v1.CreateContractRequest.description:
CreateContractRequest stages a new contract from a won lead. Signing can
happen now or later via update.

lead_id.description: lead_id links the contract to its winning lead.

mrr.description: mrr is monthly recurring revenue as a decimal string.

plan.description: plan is what was bought, as CRM displays it.

seats.description: seats is how many users the contract covers.

signed_at.description:
signed_at completes the signature at creation time; absent means an
unsigned draft.

crm.sales.v1.CreateContractResponse.description: CreateContractResponse returns the newly staged contract.

contract.description: contract is the record as stored.

crm.sales.v1.GetContractRequest.description: GetContractRequest selects one contract by id.

id.description: id is the contract id path parameter.

crm.sales.v1.GetContractResponse.description:
GetContractResponse returns the requested contract, or a 404 error when it
does not exist in the caller's business.

crm.sales.v1.ListContractsRequest.description:
ListContractsRequest selects contracts for this business. Filters combine
with AND. The response is always a page: follow offset until total is
reached.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, capped by the server.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

signed.description:
signed filters to contracts whose signing is complete when true, or
incomplete when false; absent to include both.

crm.sales.v1.ListContractsResponse.description:
ListContractsResponse returns one page of contracts with paging echoes,
matching the rest of this module's list surfaces.

contracts.description: contracts is the page of contracts matching the filters.

limit.description: limit echoes the applied page size.

total.description: total is the number of contracts across all pages.

crm.sales.v1.UpdateContractBody.description: UpdateContractBody is the amendable surface of a contract.

mrr.description: mrr replaces monthly recurring revenue (decimal string).

notes.description: notes replace the free-text sales notes.

plan.description: plan replaces what the contract says was bought.

seats.description: seats replaces the covered user count.

signed_at.description:
signed_at records the signature; setting it on an unsigned draft makes
the contract billable. Already-signed contracts keep their original
timestamp unless explicitly replaced here.

crm.sales.v1.UpdateContractRequest.description:
UpdateContractRequest amends an existing contract. Fields left absent keep
their current values, except status-bearing fields which replace outright.

body.description: body carries the amendable fields bound from the HTTP payload.

id.description: id is the contract id path parameter.

contract.description: contract is the record after amendment.

get.description: Returns one page of contracts for this business.

schema.description:
signed filters to contracts whose signing is complete when true, or
incomplete when false; absent to include both.
Maximum number of records to return, capped by the server.
Number of records to skip for pagination.

post.description: Stages a new contract from a won lead.

get.description: Returns a single contract by id.
